text: All invoices over $10,000 require a purchase order number before payment can be processed.
Vendors must be on the approved vendor list before any payment is issued.
Invoice amounts more than 2x the vendor's historical average require manager approval.
Data processing agreements must include GDPR Article 28 clauses when handling EU personal data.
Personal data transfers outside the EU require Standard Contractual Clauses or an adequacy decision.
Contracts with value exceeding $100,000 must be reviewed by the legal department.
All financial transactions must be logged with timestamp, amount, currency, and counterparty.
Signatures on contracts must be dated within 30 days of the contract effective date.
